intro: Gentlemen, Gameweek 1 is in the books and Asher has already gone and made it look easy. 80 points for Back to Back, 21 clear of Ben in second and 52 clear of Brahmes at the bottom. Arsenal beat Coventry 3-0, Brighton put four past Villa, and Newcastle and Liverpool shared a 2-2. Hull beat Man Utd 2-0, which will have rattled a few of you. Ben and Jonny sit 2nd and 3rd, Louie and Jack are level on 42, and Jamie and Josh share 37. Brahmes is rock bottom on 28. It's one week in, so nobody panic. Brahmes, you can start now.
motw: Asher, 80 points, and it wasn't close. De Cuyper alone brought 17 with a goal, an assist, a clean sheet and 2 bonus. Gakpo added 12 and White 11. Gvardiol, Saka and Ndiaye chipped in 9 each. The title race is ON, except it isn't, because he's already 21 clear. Never in doubt.
stinker: Brahmes, 28 points and last place. Top scorer Rogers got 8, and then it fell away quickly: Virgil and Cunha got 2 each. Three Spurs players sat on the bench or did nothing. Spurs lost 3-0 at Brentford, so that's on the selection. Three transfers were made this week and not one of them rescued it. Absolute scenes, and not the good kind.
bench: Josh and Jack share this one, each leaving 10 points on the bench. Josh will be most annoyed, as Trafford sat there with 9 points and a clean sheet for Leeds. Jack left Muharemović on the bench for 6 after bringing him in on waivers. The bench is where points go to die, gentlemen. Josh and Jack just sent flowers.
bench_jam: Jonny gets the jam. Dewsbury-Hall came on for Amad and returned 11 points with a goal, a clean sheet and 3 bonus. Amad was only picked up this week on a free agent swap that also moved Dorgu. Sometimes the auto-sub does the thinking for you. You can't buy that, and Jonny didn't even have to.
red_card: Jonny again, and this one is Cash of Aston Villa. He finished on -1 after conceding 4 at Brighton, plus a yellow card. Ninety minutes of 4-0 is a long afternoon. Jonny still finished third, so the injury is to pride only. Hospital ball into his own box.
gloves: Brahmes takes the gloves with Lammens of Man Utd. He picked up 1 point, conceded 2 and made 2 saves in the 2-0 loss at Hull. That's a keeper doing his best against a defence doing less. It also matches the rest of the week for Brahmes. Squeaky bum time already.

xi.385: Trafford kept a clean sheet for Leeds and got 9 points with 3 saves and 2 bonus. Josh left him on the bench. Bold stuff.
xi.115: 17 points for a defender with a goal, an assist and a clean sheet. Asher owns him, naturally. Worldie of a week.
xi.10: White got an assist and a clean sheet for 11 points. Another Asher defender banking the lot.
xi.388: Guéhi scored for Man City and bagged 10 points. Louie's quiet little differential.
xi.154: Palmer scored, assisted and picked up 3 bonus for 13 points. Ben will be buzzing.
xi.335: Stach scored and had 16 defensive contributions for 13 points. Jack's best player by a distance. Played himself into form on day one.
xi.367: Gakpo scored in the 2-2 at Newcastle for 12 points. Asher again, because of course.
xi.15: Ødegaard scored in 75 minutes for 11 points. Jonny's week was a good one.
xi.236: Dewsbury-Hall scored for Everton from the bench, courtesy of an auto-sub. Jonny gets 11 points he didn't plan on.
xi.165: João Pedro scored and assisted in Chelsea's 3-2 win at Fulham for 11 points. Josh was happy with that one.
xi.316: Emersonn scored for Ipswich in 65 minutes for 9 points. Louie's waiver pickup paid off straight away.
